spearheads.name: Spitewing Flight
spearheads.text:
Ever since the restoration of the Oak of Ages Past and the Rite of Life, that grand ritual performed by Alarielle to reverse the effects of the Necroquake, the sound of huge, buzzing wings overhead has been heard across the domains of the Everqueen. Despoilers of nature have learned to dread that sound, for it often heralds the coming of a Spitewing Flight, an aerial squadron of elite Sylvaneth riders sent to destroy an emerging enemy threat.
This fast-moving formation is led by an Arch-Revenant, a winged forest spirit whose experience of battle encompasses many long seasons. These superlative commanders draw upon the rich bounty of shared memories within the spirit-song to trace paths though the thickest wilds, striking wherever their quarry is weakest. Gossamid Archers open hostilities with a rain of living arrows that eat through flesh, whilst Spiterider Lancers charge forth to slay their targets with magical spears and the ripping mandibles of their beloved dragonspite mounts. Finally, Revenant Seekers swoop down in the wake of the initial strike, scattering the survivors and reaping lives with each deft strike from their gleaming sickles.

battle_traits.name: TARGET OF VENGEANCE
battle_traits.declare: If there is no enemy quarry on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: The target is the quarry for the rest of the battle.

battle_traits.name: AIRBORNE COHESION
battle_traits.effect: Friendly units have a coherency range of 2".

battle_traits.name: SONG OF THE HUNT
battle_traits.effect:
You gain 1 chord each time an enemy quarry is destroyed. The following cumulative effects apply depending on the number of chords you have:
1 chord Simple: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly units while they are within 9" of the enemy quarry. 2 chords Tuneful: Add 1 to hit rolls for friendly units’ attacks while they are within 9" of the enemy quarry. 3+ chords Melodic: Add 1 to wound rolls for friendly units’ attacks while they are within 9" of the enemy quarry.

regiment_abilities.name: LEAVES ON THE WIND
regiment_abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to be the target.
regiment_abilities.effect: The target can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase and no mortal damage is inflicted on it if it does so.

enhancements.name: HEAD OF THE HUNT
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general’s melee weapons while the enemy quarry is within 9" of and visible to them.

enhancements.name: BOLD SPIRIT
enhancements.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for friendly units’ combat attacks while they are within your general’s combat range.

enhancements.name: ZEPHYRKIN
enhancements.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for your general
enhancements.effect: If your general charged this turn, they can move up to 2D6" after that FIGHT ability has been resolved. They cannot end that move in combat.

enhancements.name: CUNNING PURSUER
enhancements.effect: While your general is in combat, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly units wholly within 12" of them. Add 2 instead while your general is in combat with the quarry.

abilities.name: HEARTWOOD HUNTING HORN
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, when determining which effects of the ‘Song of the Hunt’ ability apply to the target, you count as having 1 additional chord.

abilities.name: ZEPHYRSPITES
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: After that SHOOT ability has been resolved, this unit can move up to D6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: SPITERIDER CHARGE
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. Add 1 to the roll if the target is the enemy quarry. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: DEAFENING DRONE
abilities.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

spearheads.name: Bitterbark Copse
spearheads.text:
A Bitterbark Copse is a gathering of Sylvaneth that channels the spirit-song of Alarielle’s warlike Summer Aspect to purge the enemies of natural law. They are led by a Branchwych, a vengeful creature of bark and briar that cleaves through foes with their scythe. Fiercely protective of both their forest and their kin, each Branchwych wields verdant magic that allows them to weave sundered Sylvaneth barkflesh back together or add a thorned edge to their enchanted weapons.
Alongside them stride the wood-sinewed warriors of the Copse. Kurnoth Hunters fire with devastating accuracy from the back lines. They are uniquely in tune with the vibrations of the realmroots, allowing them to draw upon Alarielle’s might wherever they might be. Defending them are the Tree-Revenants, fey beings imbued with the memories of their fallen ancestors, who have ever sought to protect natural places of power. With centuries of experience to draw on, they are martial experts, able to switch between attacking and defending with natural fluidity. Each Copse is also accompanied by a Treelord, an ancient arboreal giant. Each one has lived for untold years, growing ever taller, wiser and more fearsome in battle.

battle_traits.name: LEY LINES
battle_traits.effect: Heal (1) each friendly unit that is within 3" of any terrain features.

battle_traits.name: STRIKE AND FADE
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within 3" of any terrain features, then roll a dice.
battle_traits.effect: On a 2+, remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again so that each model in the unit is within 3" of any terrain features and more than 6" from all enemy units.

regiment_abilities.name: VENGEFUL SPIRITS OF THE LAND
regiment_abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that is contesting an objective and roll a dice.
regiment_abilities.effect: On a 4+, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

regiment_abilities.name: WALKERS OF THE HIDDEN PATHS
regiment_abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is within 3" of any terrain features and not in combat.
regiment_abilities.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 6" from all enemy units. That unit cannot use MOVE abilities for the rest of the phase.

enhancements.name: REGROWTH
enhancements.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

enhancements.name: TREESONG
enhancements.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
enhancements.effect: On a 7+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target unit’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: GNARLED WARRIOR
enhancements.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for your general.

enhancements.name: SEED OF REBIRTH
enhancements.effect: If your general would be destroyed, before removing them from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, your general is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on them have no effect. Then, Heal (1) your general. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: VERDUROUS HARMONY
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: On a 7+, you can return 1 slain model to the target unit. If you picked a Tree-Revenants unit, you can return D3 slain models instead of 1.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Massive Impaling Talons is 1.

abilities.name: GROUNDSHAKER
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target, then roll a dice.
abilities.effect: On a 4+, the target has STRIKE-LAST this phase.

abilities.name: ENVOYS OF THE EVERQUEEN
abilities.effect: While this unit is contesting an objective, friendly units contesting that objective have WARD (6+).

abilities.name: MARTIAL MEMORIES
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply to this unit this phase:

options.name: Memories of War
options.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit.

options.name: Memories of Peace
options.text: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit.
